elements.label: Figure O.1
elements.title: Standards have a great impact on development
elements.content:
A conceptual diagram showing the 'Development trajectory' through three stages:
1. Adapt -> Adapt international standards for the domestic market.
2. Align -> Align the domestic market with international standards.
3. Author -> Shape international standards with the global community.

Axes and elements:
- Vertical axis shows 'International standards' (dashed line) and 'Domestic standards' (solid line).
- A blue curving line/arrow titled 'Drive global knowledge' moves upward along the trajectory toward the 'Path to higher standards'.
- Source: WDR 2025 team.
